issue_context.title: Add an EVP demo for CMAC
issue_context.body:
Suggestion: CMAC - AES-256 but not compulsory.

It should be the current best practice (fetch), have proper error handling and resource allocation/deallocation and be in the style of a known answer test.

review_comments: Use valgrind.. This leaks currently. OSSL_LIB_CTX_set0_default() is probably the reason.
